modelSettings.pageDescription: Choose the LLM model to use for each LLM call site in the system
modelSettings.coreCardDescription: These stages produce invoice field values. Non-Azure models can be assigned, but the pipeline keeps running on Azure until an accuracy regression and per-model confidence recalibration pass.
modelSettings.lowRiskCardDescription: Classification and validation stages. Non-Azure models take effect immediately, provided the provider is explicitly allowed to receive sensitive data.

stages.stage1Description: Identify the forwarder/company the document belongs to
stages.stage2Description: Match the document format to apply the corresponding configuration
stages.stage3Description: Extract structured field data from the document
stages.visionExtractionDescription: Extract invoice content from a document image with a vision model
stages.unifiedExtractionDescription: Extract all fields in one call, used by the V3 single-pass pipeline
stages.miniExtractorDescription: Text-only field extraction used by document preview and field mapping
stages.visionClassificationDescription: Identify the document issuer and document type only, without extracting data
stages.termClassificationDescription: Classify invoice terms into standard charge categories (mapping tier 3)
stages.termValidationDescription: Tell genuine charge terms apart from addresses, names and reference numbers

modelSettings.readOnlyNotice: Only global administrators can change model settings. This is a read-only view.
modelSettings.gatewayDisabledNotice: The LLM gateway is switched off, and this stage is only reached through it, so the assignment is stored but never read. Extraction stages 1-3 are unaffected — they take effect regardless. Turn on FEATURE_LLM_GATEWAY_ENABLED to activate this one.
modelSettings.accuracyWarning: This is a core extraction stage. Non-Azure models require an accuracy regression pass and per-model confidence recalibration (Story 23.3) before use. The selection is saved, but the pipeline keeps running on Azure until then.

actions.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset this setting to its default value?
